notes.title: v0.91 update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone and Happy New Year 2025,

We're starting off the year with an update for our multiplayer mode, please check the following list of changes :

[list]
[*] [h3]Color Picker[/h3]
Choose the color of your character before the game starts
[*] [h3]Global Malus[/h3]
Sending trouble to your opponent is fun but where's the spice if the world isn't coming at you itself. Now every 20s everyone will receive the same malus in its play area. Good Luck !
[*] [h3]Brawl Mode[/h3]
We're structuring a bit how the multiplayer is working and offering the first mode "Brawl". Each player will start with 3 lives, if you die, you'll respawn in the center but everything that's in your play area will remain (projectiles, lasers, platforms etc...)
[*] Side laser animation tell
Side laser are terrible opponents, so we're helping our players a bit here : before shooting the laser the side apparels will emit some particles
[*] 15+ bugfixes
[/list]

We hope you'll enjoy these changes and still more to come to the early release in January !

notes.title: Jumpy jumps to Early Access
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone !

We're very happy and proud to release [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3064530/Jumper_Jumpy_Time_Attack_Adventure/]Jumper, Jumpy Time Attack Adventure[/url] in Early Access Today !

The game features several modes :

[h3][b]Time Attack[/b][/h3]
It's you against you ! Setup the games bonus/malus you see fit and try to stay alive as long as you can. The learning curve can be steep in the beginning but we promise it smoothen quite fast... the more you jump...
If you tried the demo, you know the drill. We've added a link to Steam Leaderboards and you'll be able to see the worldwide top 10 !

[h3][b]Adventure[/b][/h3]
Jump into the story mode of Jumpy with the first level including 4 stages and a boss. Jumpy needs to get out of the cave and fight the terrible (or maybe not so terrible ?) Rooroo.

[h3][b]Multiplayer[/b][/h3]
Up to 3 players can each jump is own way up and collect malus that will affect their opponents. When the winner is chosen, then it starts again ! You can either play while sitting in front of the same screen or use Steam Remote Play Together to invite your friends on steam to play. Only one player needs to own the game, the other two can join for free !

[h3][b]What's Next !?[/b][/h3]

The early access will allow us to build a community for our game as well as getting feedback on the features we're developping. We will iterate on a number of things but 2 main features will be developped while the game is in early access :
[olist]
[*]The Adventure will expand with 2 more levels including 4 to 5 stages each and a boss. While you may have gotten out of the cave and may have vainquished the terrible Rooroo, we still have more for you to get your teeth into
[*]The Multiplayer mode will be improved with a score system to declare a winner in the battles as well as several quality of life enhancements.
[/olist]

We're eager for you to Jump in !

notes.title: Demo v2 available !!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone !

Since last week-end, we've published the second version of our game "Jumper, Jumpy Time Attack Adventure" and we've set a lot more new content :
[list]
[*]The first 5 levels of the game are available to play
[*]The first boss of the game, the evil Rooroo is waiting for you in the forest
[*]Jump mechanics, collision boxes as well as the "sticky" bonus have been reworked and fine tuned
[*]New bonuses and platforms have been added
[/list]

Going forward, the game will be in pre-alpha next month with the multiplayer update. The demo will remain available in any case.

We hope you'll enjoy this demo and beat the game !

Bests,
Bruno

notes.title: Get the Demo
notes.notes:
Hi folks, 

We're very happy to share the demo of our very first game for free ! It'll be available on July, the 22nd.

You'll be able to enjoy the base gameplay of Jumper, Jumpy Time Attack Adventure through its survival mode :
[list]
[*]Customize the difficulty by choosing which bonus or malus you'll get
[*]Start to [i][b]JUMP[/b][/i]
[*]The higher your score the faster the platform will move
[*] Get as far as you can
[/list]

More will come in the future and we hope to open the alpha for the main game soon™ and get your feedbacks.

Bests,
Bruno
